items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Needless to say, my wife was not pleased with that.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, everybody. You got to go past the shrink when you get in the military. He said, “Why didn’t you apply for OC?” I say, “The Marine Corps don’t commission music majors,” for whatever reason, not that I was looking to be a Marine officer anyway.
But you have this music – you have this degree. You’re back in New Orleans. You’re trying to get gigs. You’ve just recently married. I presume you would like to state the name of your wife?
Dolores Ferdinand. She had gone to Grambling and finished – graduated in home economics, which was considered one of the best home-ec departments in the whole state.
